## b3d7f3a15b3d

**No issue found in this finite audit; no audit-only fix applied.**

Generator SHA-256:
`3d840b93077aaf640b9f596ce1a41298424d35edcdb3e2e78d96ee6dc4029a27`.
Rule hash: `032c15e97118`.

I generated 36 cases covering all four exact `scene_profile` values, all three
difficulty bands, and seeds 17, 43, and 101. Every case passed `self_check`,
`observe_overrides` recovered the requested profile exactly, and each case
individually refuted all three declared competitors (`horizontal_only`,
`vertical_only`, and `first_special_only`). I then applied the selected Racket
authority to all 36 inputs with the supported CLI; all 36 outputs were valid and
matched the independent Python rule mirror exactly, with no execution errors.

The finite probe and protected apply record are
`checks/audit/b3d7f3a15b3d/probe.json` and
`checks/audit/b3d7f3a15b3d/racket.json`. I also checked that the schedule covers
the canonical 3×3/p5, 4×4/p5, 5×4/p6, and 5×5/p7 signatures and that generated
scenes require real horizontal and vertical synthesis by at least two colors.
This does not prove the absence of every undeclared shortcut, but I found no
concrete validator, authority, override, or declared-rival defect.
